disable.com.sprint.ms.smf.services: Sprint mobile services framework: carrier telemetry

health_script: echo '@@caelza:identity'; getprop ro.product.manufacturer; getprop ro.product.model; getprop ro.build.version.release; getprop ro.build.version.security_patch; getprop ro.build.version.sdk; echo '@@caelza:boot'; getprop ro.boot.verifiedbootstate; getprop ro.boot.flash.locked; getprop ro.debuggable; echo '@@caelza:battery'; dumpsys battery 2>/dev/null; echo '@@caelza:storage'; df -k /data 2>/dev/null; echo '@@caelza:memory'; head -5 /proc/meminfo; echo '@@caelza:uptime'; cat /proc/uptime; echo '@@caelza:thermal'; dumpsys thermalservice 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Thermal Status|mStatus' | head -2; for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp; do cat $z 2>/dev/null; done | sort -n | tail -1; echo '@@caelza:top'; top -b -n 1 -m 6 2>/dev/null | tail -n 8; echo '@@caelza:crashes'; logcat -d -b crash -t 60 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|Process: ' | head -20; echo '@@caelza:settings'; for k in adb_wifi_enabled adb_enabled development_settings_enabled stay_on_while_plugged_in window_animation_scale transition_animation_scale animator_duration_scale package_verifier_user_consent; do echo "$k=$(settings get global $k 2>/dev/null)"; done; echo '@@caelza:whitelist'; dumpsys deviceidle whitelist 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'com\.termux|com\.tailscale'; echo '@@caelza:packages'; pm list packages 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'com\.termux|com\.tailscale\.ipn'; echo '@@caelza:network'; ip -o -4 addr show 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2, $4}'; echo '@@caelza:end'

optional.com.android.chrome: Chrome (~750 MB with its sandboxes); Android System WebView is separate and stays
optional.com.google.android.apps.messaging: Google Messages; the default SMS app on many phones
optional.com.google.android.apps.photos: Google Photos; often the default gallery
optional.com.google.android.apps.turbo: Device Health Services (adaptive battery); keep unless you know why not
optional.com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox: the Google app, Discover feed and Assistant hotword (~400 MB live); disabling it also stops 'Hey Google'
optional.com.google.android.safetycore: Google on-device content scanning for Messages
optional.com.tmobile.rsuadapter.qualcomm: T-Mobile remote SIM unlock adapter; needed only to carrier-unlock the phone
optional.com.tmobile.rsuapp: T-Mobile remote SIM unlock; needed only to carrier-unlock the phone
optional.com.tmobile.rsusrv: T-Mobile remote SIM unlock service; needed only to carrier-unlock the phone
optional.com.wingos.wingcamera: the OEM camera app; the Body reaches the camera through camera2 without it

patterns.why: Digital Turbine Ignite: carrier-sponsored app installer
T-Mobile app; keep it if you use it (voicemail, Scam Shield, the T-Life app)
Verizon app; keep it if you use it
AT&T app; keep it if you use it
preloaded partner app; keep it if you use it
Samsung extra; keep it if you use it

remove.com.amazon.appmanager: Amazon app manager: installs Amazon apps in the background
remove.com.amazon.storm.lightning.client.aosp: Amazon Lightning: Fire TV remote stub, preloaded
remove.com.facebook.appmanager: Facebook app manager: installs and updates Facebook apps silently
remove.com.facebook.services: Facebook services stub: background install helper
remove.com.facebook.system: Facebook system stub: background install helper
remove.com.ironsrc.aura.tmo: ironSource Aura: pushes carrier-sponsored apps and ads (140 MB live on the REVVL 7)
remove.com.metro.minus1: Metro '-1 screen' launcher feed (363 MB live)
remove.com.metropcs.metrozone: MetroZone: carrier offers and app promotion (237 MB live)
remove.com.netflix.partner.activation: Netflix partner activation stub (the Netflix app itself is optional)
remove.com.tmobile.pr.adapt: T-Mobile 'PR adapt': silent app installs on behalf of the carrier
